task_world.public_context: The UI is a payroll correction workflow for case payroll_case_501. It should support capacity allocation for the live case while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Payroll Anomaly Remediation Matrix, preserve the finance operating context. UI shape: allocation grid plus quota meters.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Capacity Search, Simulation, Allocation, and Release
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return plain state objects; write tools return success/error wrappers and operation objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Each task includes cached, estimate, advisory, fast-track, shadow, same-domain near-miss, optimistic-status, stale-token, draft-receipt, and phrase-validation tools that are not authoritative for the requested workflow.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine no-write comparisons, scoped writes, rollback/recovery/handoff paths, fresh readback after mutation, conflict-source arbitration, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: mixed-scope rejection boundary
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must separate valid scoped work from blocked or locked alternatives without claiming a mixed bundle succeeded.

mechanism_mix.label: reversible recovery path
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must support a second-pass correction path that preserves earlier state and audit history.

validation_scenarios.name: capacity_allocation turn 1

validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI uses authoritative family tools for the open capacity pools that satisfy demand without locked or over-capacity pools; derives target ids payroll_audit_a, payroll_audit_c and blocked ids payroll_audit_b, payroll_audit_d from backend records when relevant; does not use cached, shadow, advisory, estimate, or fast-track helper outputs as current proof; re-reads case/audit after writes; and keeps assistant text consistent with actual backend state.
